purpose: Govern canonical file naming for the ordinary Glaze UI V1.2 Candidate-controlled source surface without renaming ecosystem-required native/framework paths or established root controls.

explicitPathExceptions.css/glaze-v1.2.0-candidate.css: Canonical V1.2 aggregate CSS entrypoint preserves the product-version form established by the Candidate implementation.
explicitPathExceptions.scripts/glaze_v1_2_visual_regression.py: Established V1.2 visual-regression harness uses the repository's Python snake_case convention without the validate_ prefix.
explicitPathExceptions.acceptance/v1.2-promotion-gates.candidat: Governance authority source is explicitly bound by the exact-head readiness validator; the dot-candidate form distinguishes it from target/platform acceptance records.
explicitPathExceptions.GLAZE_UI_V1_2_CANDIDATE.md: Required descriptive root governance document; uppercase root control is an approved repository-level exception.
explicitPathExceptions.MIGRATION_V1_1_TO_V1_2.md: Required descriptive root migration control; uppercase root control is an approved repository-level exception.
explicitPathExceptions.VERSION: Required conventional root version control file.

frameworkBoundaries.reason: Android, Linux/native, generated, build-system, or framework-required names must not be cosmetically normalized by Glaze naming governance.

boundaries: Canonical naming validation enforces stable descriptive path shape; it does not authorize cosmetic repository-wide renames.
An explicit exception documents an established controlled path and does not broaden naming exceptions to adjacent paths.
Nested native/framework reference trees are reported separately and remain governed by their ecosystem conventions.
A green naming workflow does not approve file contents or establish implementation, human, native, physical-device, runtime, RC, Stable, or consumer acceptance.
